articles.title: Kalshi turns to small businesses as legal battles threaten forecasts on sports
articles.snippet: The prediction market is pitching protection against tariffs, weather and other business risks as courts challenge its ability to offer sports wagers.

articles.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
articles.snippet: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

articles.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
articles.snippet: Developers have agreed to keep the planned storage charges despite concerns about some existing smart contracts, ending seven weeks of delays to the next major test.

articles.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin options positioning has flipped bearish ahead of Friday’s $7 billion expiry, with traders piling into downside protection as volatility rises.

articles.title: Bitcoin whales pile into BTC despite shrinking profit cushion
articles.snippet: CryptoQuant data shows Bitcoin whales are breaking with historical fourth-quarter selling patterns despite a market downturn.
